# Aliyah Prestige

> Private concierge in Marrakech: bespoke stays, journeys and evenings across Morocco. Family-run since 1986. One concierge per stay, a real person replying at any hour in English, French or Spanish, by WhatsApp.

## Services

- [Private Jet Charter](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/private-jet-charter): Private jet charter to Marrakech and across Morocco, arranged by your Aliyah Prestige concierge: aircraft, crew, ground transfers and your whole stay.
- [Private Villas and Luxury Stays](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/luxury-villas-riads-hotels): Private villas, riads and 5-star hotels in Marrakech, handpicked and arranged by Aliyah Prestige, from check-in to every in-room detail.
- [Private Chef and Fine Dining](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/private-chef-gastronomy): Private chefs, the finest restaurant tables, cooking classes and dinners in unique settings in Marrakech, curated by Aliyah Prestige.
- [Wellness and Spa](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/wellness-spa): Private hammam ceremonies, massages and Moroccan spa rituals in Marrakech's most select sanctuaries, arranged by Aliyah Prestige.
- [Private Tours and Cultural Experiences](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/private-cultural-tours): Private tours and bespoke cultural experiences in Marrakech with a certified multilingual guide: museums, monuments, artisans and excursions.
- [Luxury Event Planner](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/luxury-event-planner): Luxury weddings, private celebrations and corporate events in Marrakech and Morocco: full-service planning, scenography, venues and guest logistics.
- [Luxury Transportation and Chauffeurs](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/chauffeur-transportation): VIP airport welcome, private chauffeur and certified local guide in Marrakech, at your service 24/7 from arrival to departure.
- [Private Souk Experience and Personal Shopping](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/private-souk-shopping): A private souk experience and personal shopping in Marrakech with a local expert: trusted ateliers, honest pricing and authentic Moroccan craft.
- [Desert and Atlas Escapes](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/desert-atlas-escapes): Private escapes from Marrakech to the Agafay Desert, the Merzouga dunes and the Atlas Mountains: luxury bivouacs, helicopter transfers and starlit dinners.
- [24/7 Private Concierge Assistance](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/private-concierge-24-7): 24/7 private concierge assistance in Marrakech: a dedicated, discreet personal assistant who answers within minutes, in English, French and Spanish.
